$comment: Rate limits for the public gtm-<ws>-share project, applied by the gtm-workflow skill's setup and checked by doctor. Rules are matched by name; the 'GTM share:' prefix marks them as template-owned. Traffic the firewall answers with 429 is not billed.

rules.name: GTM share: intake relay
rules.description: Webhook senders. A booking burst stays well under 120 a minute per sender address.

rules.name: GTM share: viewer API
rules.description: Share-link reads. One open tab polls about 6 times a minute; 300 leaves room for a shared office address.

rules.name: GTM share: pages
rules.description: The share page, its assets and everything else. A page load is about ten requests.
